promotion_note: Promoted 2026-07-24 (miso-85, owner instruction): re-solve of the net-revenue-margin keeper form (gas_offer_margin=true, the go-forward fuel-invariant $/MWh gas offer, anchor 3.0492 $/MMBtu, unchanged) with a second delta, miso_native_outage_source=true — MISO's own published Multiday Operating Margin outage record (region x cause, UNPLANNED components: Derated+Forced+Unplanned) REPLACING the CAMPD unit-level derate. Full span 2023-2025, one bundle, per-year chained (rule 16); zero fitted scalars, both new DOF entries measured-physical. Determination stays NOT-YET but the failing set changes from the superseded 2026-07-24-miso-83-netrev-margin keeper: C1 fuel-mix FAILs (2023 COAL_PRB +28.3 TWh/+5.1pp, CC_REGULAR -22.7 TWh; 2024 +21.1/-14.8 TWh), C3a mean LMP FAILs (2025 +43.5%, opposite-direction from the inherited ledgered caveat so not inherited), and C3b price-shape FAILs all three years (NRMSE 0.284/0.306/1.072) — all recorded as UNLEDGERED MODEL MISSes, nothing tuned to rescue them. Root cause measured and OPEN (rule 11): MISO publishes outages only at region x cause grain with no unit/fuel identity, so the admissible transform is a uniform 0.184/0.205/0.237 unavailability envelope, while the per-unit CAMPD record it replaces measures COAL 0.33/0.33/0.26, ST_GAS 0.59/0.53/0.51, CC_REGULAR 0.20/0.21/0.25, CT 0.00 — so ~5 GW of coal returns to merit order and displaces CC gas, and ~4-5 GW comes off a peaking fleet the per-unit record never says was out (manufacturing the 2025 price tail). Kept per rule 1 (structure over fit): the measured MISO record is preferred over the fitted CAMPD derate even though it degrades the fit. Supersedes 2026-07-24-miso-83-netrev-margin (adds the outage-source delta on top of its net-revenue-margin structure).
